name: Shibuya Aoi
source:
A third-year from another middle school participating in the extracurricular activities camp. She is a hard worker who does her best to deal with the unreasonable demands and complaints of her peers. She is usually quiet, rarely speaking. In the unknown world, she undertakes detailed work such as food management and base management, and she does it well.

Her digimon partner is Labramon.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2018/09/digimon-survive-details-story-takuma-and-agumon-aoi-and-labramon-and-minoru-and-falcomon]Gematsu's translation[/url]]
